# Membrane FFmpeg Transcoder Plugin v1.6.1 - Table of Contents

Membrane plugin to transcode audio and video into different qualities using FFmpeg

## Modules

- [Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder](https://membrane-ffmpeg-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.md): Tasks as input an unparsed stream and provides on each pad an unparsed, transcoded stream
with the desired properties.
- [Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Application](https://membrane-ffmpeg-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Application.md)
- [Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Filter](https://membrane-ffmpeg-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Filter.md): Internal module. Outputs MPEG-TS as an unparsed remote stream.
## Pads

- Exceptions
  - [Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Filter.FFmpegError](https://membrane-ffmpeg-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Filter.FFmpegError.md)
